turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I am sorry Owen found out on his phone.
Okay. Now tell me what the zero rests on.
Here is the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Turn the screen and read it yourself.
I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52, 11:58. People draft on paper or on their phones and paste it in at the end, Hale. Was Owen asked about any of this before that zero went in?
If he drafted it somewhere else, that file has its own dates. Bring it and I will look at it with you. Until then, this is the only history there is.
Then he'll bring it. Whatever comes of this, nothing goes on his record and nothing gets said in front of his class. And you still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero.
Second: the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. Here is the whole play on my screen. Search every edition you like; the line is not in Hamlet.
Give me the screen. Seventeen-year-olds misremember lines all the time, and a bad quotation earns a bad mark, not a zero.
It is not a misremembered line. There is no line in the play close to it. Search the word exile yourself.
Exile. There's nothing near it. What are you putting on the table?
Third: his in-class writing from September 24. 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices, no quotations. The essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line. Here are both, side by side.
Forty minutes under a clock in September is not a take-home essay in October. Anyone writes better with time and a copy of the play open.

Under procedure 4.4 this is a first concern. A supervised rewrite, private, not in front of his class. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I will put that in writing tonight.

Your own procedure, then. Owen will do the rewrite, to put this behind him, not because of anything he did. Tonight's email says private, supervised, its mark replaces the zero, nothing on his record, and an apology for how he found out.
Will he do it?
Yes. Put the date and the room in that email.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you agreed that, under procedure 4.4, Owen will complete a private, supervised rewrite whose mark replaces the zero, with nothing placed on his record. I still expect the date and room for that rewrite, and your apology for how Owen learned of the zero, set out in the same email. I expect that in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Last position: she agreed to a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, and she still wants the written confirmation with the date, the room and your apology; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and you reached it well before her call.
What moved her: You showed the version history with its exact late-night times and then answered her pasted-in-from-elsewhere defence with a check she could make, because it was specific, dated, tied to his work and checkable.
What cost ground: Nothing cost you ground, though you twice let her question go unanswered about whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero went in.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, running from 11:31 to 11:58 PM the night before the essay was due, came very close to that kind of night, which is why she went short and hard on procedure there; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked whether Owen was heard before the zero, answer it plainly against procedure 4.1 right then, because owning that gap early takes away her strongest procedural weapon.
